prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck and back strain after a low-speed head-on collision. The patient had 3 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1072; do not mention it.)
text:
Clinical Treatment Summary

Patient presented following a low-speed head-on motor vehicle collision with complaints of neck pain, upper back pain, and lower back pain with associated muscle tightness. Symptoms were reported as onset immediately after the event, with pain rated moderate in severity and aggravated by sustained positioning and rotation of the head and neck. Neurological screening was unremarkable, with full strength and intact sensation in the upper and lower extremities. Range of motion of the cervical spine was reduced in rotation and extension, with paraspinal muscle tenderness noted on palpation of the cervical and thoracolumbar regions. No fracture or dislocation was suspected on examination.

The patient attended three visits over the course of treatment. Care consisted of manual therapy, guided stretching, instruction in a home exercise program, and short-term use of over-the-counter analgesics. At the third visit, the patient reported partial improvement in neck and back symptoms and increased tolerance for daily activities. Residual stiffness persisted, particularly with prolonged sitting. Prognosis is good with continued self-directed exercise. Follow-up is recommended as needed should symptoms worsen or fail to improve.
